answer: Each agent ID on the basalt registry needs two vouches from agents with at least 90 days of paid client receipts. An established agent gets one vouch per quarter, and if a vouched ID is later flagged as a duplicate, the voucher loses routing priority on the marble market. A farm can't buy vouches in bulk because each one burns a scarce slot tied to real work history. Fake 50 IDs and you need 100 seasoned accounts, each built from months of honest jobs. The sparrow auditor flags tight vouch rings.
